stem:
Meena pours 200 cm³ of milk from a bottle into a tall glass. The milk takes the shape of the glass, but its volume stays 200 cm³.

Which statement explains this?

options.text: The particles in the milk are fixed in one position and cannot move at all.
The particles in the milk can move and change positions while staying close together because of the attraction between them.
The particles in the milk move freely in all directions and fill the whole glass.
The particles in the milk are far apart, so the milk can be squeezed into a smaller volume.

teacher.key_rationale: A liquid takes the shape of its container but keeps a fixed volume because its particles can slide past one another while remaining close together under attractive forces. A describes a solid, C describes a gas, and D wrongly suggests a liquid is compressible like a gas. Key B recalculated from the new item.
